cross_dataset_question_overlap.method: normalized task question (>=20 chars): exact equality and equality of first 60 normalized chars; OLD:* = r51 sets, others = r53 sets

grand_total_new.rule: union over AgentRx + TRAIL (all trajectory text), exact segment dedup between them, segments already present in ANY previously measured set removed (old 5 from r51: AEGIS, MAST-Data, Who&When, TraceElephant, Who&When-Pro tmpxv7 real files; all r53 sets: CORRECT-Error, AFTraj, ARIA, Who&When-Pro mirror text+video, AgentErrorBench, MAScope MAST-clean/LG-Ctrl/Inject-Mix, ATBench, ATBench500; segmentation identical to r53), trajectories flagged medical removed (keyword heuristic >=2 distinct medical terms in the task question); a segment shared by a natural/clean and an injected trajectory is credited to natural/clean
grand_total_new.mas_only_strict_definition: as mas_only, but TRAIL/gaia restricted to the traces in which the manager actually delegated to search_agent (ToolCallingAgent.run span present)
grand_total_new.mas_only_definition: AgentRx/magentic (Magentic-One) + TRAIL/gaia (manager CodeAgent + search_agent); drops AgentRx/tau_retail (single agent + LLM user simulator) and TRAIL/swe_bench (single CodeAgent)
